item.title: Shakira & Burna Boy’s World Cup Song ‘Dai Dai’ Scores Second Week at No. 1 on Global Excl. U.S. Chart
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update! We've got some exciting news from the Billboard charts. Shakira and Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai (FIFA World Cup Official Song 2026)' is still on top of the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart for the second week in a row. This song made history last week as the first official World Cup anthem to reach number one on this chart, which started in 2020."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Meanwhile, Ariana Grande's 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' is holding strong at number one on the Billboard Global 200 chart for the second week. This song has tied her previous records for longest time at number one, matching 'Yes, And?' in 2024 and 'Positions' in 2020."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But that's not all. 'Dai Dai' has seen a significant boost in streams and sales, with 34.4 million streams and 4,000 sales outside the U.S. last week. And, Shakira and Burna Boy performed this song to a massive crowd of over 80,000 fans at the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening ceremony in Mexico City."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Other notable mentions on the charts include BTS' 'Swim' at number two on the Global Excl. U.S. chart, and Olivia Rodrigo's 'Stupid Song' dropping to number two on the Global 200 chart. We'll be keeping an eye on these charts as the FIFA World Cup continues, and we can't wait to see who'll be performing at the first-ever World Cup final halftime show on July 19th."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this music update. For more chart news and updates, follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on social media. We'll see you next time!"
